column1: # blocco-d.mirror.tsv — the messages of block D, lane 2b: fic-mirror.sh, test-fast.sh and vitest-classify.py, read
# by tools/lingua-converti.py (format: its docstring). The first row of a key is its source in v1.3.0, the following
# ones its twins. Rows of Python sites (.py files, !f) and of the !d mode feed the catalog and the check; their code
# was edited by hand, and so were the sites inside $(…) that the converter does not see (fic-mirror.sh:352).
# Frozen and not here: the prefixes «vitest-fast: », «vitest-fast: esito=<STATO> (» … «) luogo=<luogo>» (gates.sh reads
# the outcome word), «equivalenza=», «sync=», the whole luogo= field with its declaration «luogo=mnt-c (ripiego…)»,
# the value «interrotto» of .fic-deps and the classes of vitest-classify (written to the WSL wrapper).
